The S&P 500 closed at 7,483 on July 8, up 0.3%. Semiconductor names were mixed: NVIDIA rose 1.2% while Micron fell 2.1% after its rally. Analysts at two banks maintain year-end targets of 8,000 and 7,100 respectively. Q2 earnings season begins next week with the large banks reporting first. Investors weighed the possibility of a rate hike at the July FOMC meeting.
